field.label: Enable NetDefense
field.help: This will activate the NetDefense Agent service.

field.label: Registration Token
field.help: UUID token for NetDefense server registration.

field.label: Device ID
field.help: Unique UUID identifier for this device (auto-generated when page loads if empty). Use the "Reset ID" button to generate a new UUID.

field.label: Server Address
field.help: NetDefense server URL (e.g., https://hub.netdefense.io or https://example.com:8443).

field.label: TLS Mode
field.help: What the connections to NetDefense, the relay of remote sessions included, verify the server against. System: the roots built into the agent plus Extra CA File, never the firewall's certificate store. Custom CA: only the CAs of CA File, for a NetDefense server with a private CA. SPKI pinned: only the server keys of SPKI Hashes. Trust material that cannot be used refuses every connection. See https://netdefense.io/docs/ndagent/configuration/#tls-mode

field.label: CA File
field.help: TLS Mode Custom CA: path to a PEM file of the CA certificates trusted, alone, for the connections to NetDefense; it must hold the CA of the relay (Pathfinder Address) too. The file must be owned by root and writable by root alone, in a directory only root can write.

field.label: SPKI Hashes
field.help: TLS Mode SPKI pinned: the NetDefense server keys trusted, as sha256/ and base64, separated by commas or spaces (up to 16): the key of the server and the key of the relay (Pathfinder Address). Pin only a key you control: a certificate from a public CA usually comes with a new key at each renewal. Add the next key before a key changes.

field.label: SSL Verification
field.help: No longer honoured since agent 1.31.0: the connections to NetDefense are always verified, under TLS Mode. Shown only while it is off.

field.label: TOFU Key Fetch SSL Verification
field.help: No longer honoured since agent 1.31.0: the trust key fetch is always verified, under TLS Mode. Shown only while it is off.

field.label: Extra CA File
field.help: Optional path to a PEM file of CA certificates trusted for the connections to NetDefense besides the built-in roots, under TLS Mode System. Set it only when this firewall reaches the internet through a TLS-inspection proxy. See https://netdefense.io/docs/ndagent/configuration/#extra-ca-file

field.label: Pathfinder Address
field.help: Pathfinder server URL for remote shell connections.

field.label: Pathfinder SSL Verification
field.help: No longer honoured since agent 1.31.0: the relay connection is always verified, under TLS Mode. Shown only while it is off.

field.label: Remote Access Policy
field.help: Device-local ceiling on remote access. "Full access" permits shell, SSH and web UI. "Read-only web UI only" clamps every remote session to the web UI with no shell, whatever privilege the requester holds. "Disabled" refuses remote sessions outright. This is the device's final word: the ceiling is enforced here on the firewall and cannot be raised remotely — not by an operator account, not by a configuration sync, not by the NetDefense platform. Note it governs NetDefense remote sessions only; it does not restrict configuration sync, which is gated separately by "Reject Dangerous Snippet Content".

field.label: Allow All Snippet Content
field.help: Off by default: broad privileges, system scope, interactive shells, SSH keys, Zabbix sudo, adding or changing authentication servers, the login order, and adding or updating certificates and CAs are refused. See https://netdefense.io/docs/ndagent/configuration/#allow-all-snippet-content

field.label: Re-bind Token
field.help: One-time token from your NetDefense administrator (issued via "ndcli device rebind-token <name>"). Paste here to re-bind this device's signing key — used after a suspected key leak, hardware replacement, or routine rotation. The agent rotates its keypair automatically when this field is set. Clear this field once the device shows ENABLED again.
